item.title: 'No deadline for Sheikh Hasina's return', says Indian high commissioner in Bangladesh
item.description: High Commissioner Dinesh Trivedi addressed the extradition request for Sheikh Hasina from Bangladesh, stating that the matter is under legal review, preventing a set timeline for her repatriation. He clarified that India had no involvement in her arrival, citing the dire circumstances in Bangladesh. As relations between India and Bangladesh grow increasingly strained, the new Bangladeshi government remains resolute in pursuing Hasina's extradition.

item.title: How landlord won tax relief on Rs 14.96 lakh demonetisation cash deposit
item.description: The Bangalore bench of the Income Tax Appellate Tribunal (ITAT) recently held that rental income already disclosed to the income tax authorities can be considered as an identifiable source of cash deposited into a bank account at a later date. Even where a landlord claims to have collected rent in cash, the subsequent deposit of that money cannot be disregarded merely because the rental earnings have already been taxed.

item.title: What took 10 Google engineers six months now happens overnight, says Eric Schmidt
item.description: Former Google CEO Eric Schmidt says the best programmers no longer write code. Speaking at Harvard's John F. Kennedy Jr. Forum, Schmidt described an engineer who writes specifications and evaluation criteria, lets AI run overnight, and wakes up to finished work. He argued AI will make top engineers more valuable, automate core business operations like billing and logistics, and predicted artificial general intelligence (AGI) could arrive as early as 2029.
item.dc:creator: TOI TECH DESK

item.title: Texas ranching family protects 6,409 acres in $8.863m conservation deal
item.description: The historic T.M. O'Connor Ranch in Texas has gained a notable conservation easement, protecting nearly 6,409 acres of precious coastal prairie while enabling ranching operations to persist. Made feasible through a combination of federal and private funding under the RESTORE program, this area plays a pivotal role in supporting over 300 distinct wildlife species and rare flora. This agreement showcases a united front for conservation efforts alongside sustainable farming solutions.

item.title: Travis Kelce and Patrick Mahomes' 1587 restaurant lawsuit takes new turn
item.description: Amid ongoing trademark issues, Travis Kelce and Patrick Mahomes are throwing their weight behind 1587 Prime, which has just garnered a spot on Yelp's list of Best New Restaurants for 2026. The dispute involves trademark claims from 1587 Sneakers, alleging infringement concerning their sneaker line. Seeking to distance the athletes from the legal matter, their lawyers are taking action while 1587 Prime thrives amid the conflict.

item.title: How Maria Sharapova built a $220 million fortune beyond tennis
item.description: Sharapova used her tennis success to build a bigger business career after retiring. Her estimated $220 million fortune has been tied to career earnings, global endorsements, Sugarpova and investments in consumer, wellness, fitness and technology companies, allowing the five-time Grand Slam champion to build a financial portfolio outside of professional tennis.
item.dc:creator: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK

item.title: Florida county pays $7.8m for 625-acre ranch, stopping 52-home development
item.description: In a bid to safeguard a crucial ecological area, Collier County has finalized an agreement to buy Wildflowerz Ranch, preventing any residential construction on its expansive 625 acres. Valued at approximately $7.8 million after two years of negotiations, this acquisition underscores the county's dedication to conservation and wildlife protection. Additionally, the ranch's current cattle operations will remain intact under a lease that lasts until the end of 2027.

item.title: Maryland homeowner gets $234,368 check for home; new law bans such offers
item.description: Effective October 1, Maryland introduced legislation banning unsolicited checks sent with home purchase offers. This initiative is designed to safeguard homeowners from misleading marketing strategies from property investors. Consumer advocates highlighted the risk of vulnerable owners being tricked into agreements upon receiving such checks. Historical precedents in consumer lending underline the necessity for legal protections, advising homeowners against accepting random financial items received through mail.

item.title: Helicopters, influencers and nail art: The money trail of 2026 assembly elections
item.description: The BJP and Congress have filed their election expenditure reports following several assembly elections this year. The BJP recorded a hefty expenditure of Rs 529.39 crore across five states, whereas Congress spent Rs 248.55 crore. These contrasting figures unveil the distinct priorities of the political parties, particularly in West Bengal and Keralam.

item.title: Congress resets Team UP: 5 clear messages for BJP and Akhilesh Yadav
item.description: Congress has overhauled its Uttar Pradesh unit ahead of the 2027 UP assembly election, appointing three-time MLA Aradhana Misra Mona as state president and Imran Masood as working president. The Congress reshuffle brings Brahmin, Muslim, OBC, Dalit and women representation into its leadership team, signalling a push to rebuild its organisation, expand its social base and strengthen its position in talks with Samajwadi Party.
item.dc:creator: PALLAVI

item.title: Russia to take 70,000 Indian skilled workers this year, Jaishankar tells panel
item.description: External Affairs Minister S Jaishankar briefed a parliamentary committee on India's engagement with Russia and Ukraine. He highlighted bilateral trade expansion and India's aim to send skilled workers. The minister discussed India's diplomatic efforts to facilitate dialogue for ending the Ukraine conflict. Additionally, he noted the government's initiatives to release Indian nationals in the Russian military. Jaishankar emphasized India's commitment to secure economic interests and safeguard Indian citizens abroad.

item.description: Akhilesh Yadav, president of the Samajwadi Party, encouraged leaders to express seat-sharing concerns privately. Tensions arose after Shiv Pal Singh Patel criticized Congress' demand for 150 seats in upcoming elections. Uttar Pradesh Congress president Aradhana Mishra stated that top leadership will decide the seat allocation.
